title: docs(data): a structured groupBy alias is the row key on the SQL face too
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

Fixes #35015

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两页文档各改一句。`queries.mdx` 原来说「SQL 驱动忽略结构化 groupBy 的 `alias`，结果列永远叫字段名」；`query-syntax.mdx` 原来说「`alias` 只在内存路径生效」。现在两处都改为：下推到数据库和内存兜底两条路径上，结果列都叫 `alias`。另加一个 driver-sql 测试文件，在每种方言上钉住结果行的键。
- 为什么改：在 SQLite 和 PostgreSQL 16 上实测 `engine.aggregate`，下推和内存兜底两条路径都返回 `alias` 作为列名。驱动自 #6401 起就这样做，旧文档是过期的。查询技能 `aggregation.md` 写的是对的，没有改动。
- 风险与回滚：只改文档，加了一个测试文件，没有产品代码，也没有发布面；回滚就是还原这个 PR。
- 先看：`content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx` 第 714–718 行，`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-35015-groupby-alias-row-key.test.ts`，`content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx` 第 1151 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run src/sql-driver-35015-groupby-alias-row-key.test.ts`，预期 sqlite 4 条用例通过；设置 `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` 时 PG 也是 4 条通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `content/docs/data-modeling/queries.mdx`, in the date-bucketing warn callout. The old paragraph said the SQL driver ignores a structured `groupBy` node's `alias` and "always projects the bucket under the **field name**". It now says the alias renames the projected column on both paths, that grouping still keys on the field, that the result is read under `alias ?? field`, and that `having` references that name. Once an alias is set, a `having` on the field name is refused.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx:1151`: "(or `alias`, on the in-memory path)" now reads "or under `alias` when the node sets one (pushed down or in memory alike)". This file joined the claim through amendment 6964093495.
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-35015-groupby-alias-row-key.test.ts` (new, test only). It runs on every `DIALECT_CELLS` cell and pins the exact key set of each row on the pushed-down face:
  - a quarter bucket with `alias: 'quarter'` yields keys `quarter,revenue`;
  - the unaliased control yields `closed_at,revenue`;
  - a plain alias `r` beside the bucket alias yields `quarter,r,revenue`.
- The skill (`skills/objectstack-query/rules/aggregation.md`) is **unchanged**. Its text ("results are correct either way, including the column keys"; "Read the result under `alias ?? field`, and reference that same name from `having`") matches every measured arm. No eval case was added: the order asks for one only if the skill text changes.

Because no `skills/**` file changed, this branch is cut from `origin/main` (6d2db1d7e), not from the head of #35012. It shares no file with #35012: `overlap-check` answered `VERDICT clean exit 0` against origin/main 367e324eeb, with 0 PR heads sharing a file.

## Tests

<details><summary>Phase 1 reading: engine.aggregate on a real SqlDriver, SQLite and live PostgreSQL 16.15</summary>

The probe was a scratch script (not committed). It used `ObjectQL` plus `SqlDriver` against a `datetime` field. The driver's `aggregate` and `find` were wrapped to record which path the engine took. Every run exited 0. Four runs: `sqlite`, `sqlite` with `quarter` capability off, `pg`, and `pg` with `quarter` off.

| case | sqlite | pg | keys (every arm) |
|---|---|---|---|
| bucket `alias: 'quarter'`, UTC | NATIVE | NATIVE | `quarter, revenue` |
| same, `timezone: '+00:00'` | IN-MEMORY | IN-MEMORY | `quarter, revenue` |
| same, `timezone: 'Asia/Taipei'` | IN-MEMORY | NATIVE (zoned) | `quarter, revenue` |
| same, driver declares no `quarter` | IN-MEMORY | IN-MEMORY | `quarter, revenue` |
| `having: { quarter: … }` | served, filtered | served, filtered | `quarter, revenue` |
| `having: { closed_at: … }` with alias set | INVALID_FILTER / 400 | INVALID_FILTER / 400 | refused |
| plain `{ field: 'region', alias: 'r' }` | NATIVE | NATIVE | `r, revenue` |
| plain `r` + bucket `quarter`, `+00:00` | IN-MEMORY | IN-MEMORY | `r, quarter, revenue` |
| no alias (control) | NATIVE | NATIVE | `closed_at, revenue` |

Bucket values and sums were identical on every arm (`2025-Q1 = 30`, `2025-Q2 = 12`).

The code lines that decide the key:
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-aggregation.ts:239`: `const outKey = g.alias ?? g.field`. It is used by the bucket projection (line 252) and the plain-field projection (line 276).
- `packages/objectql/src/in-memory-aggregation.ts:194`: `g.alias ?? g.field`.
- `packages/objectql/src/having-filter.ts:1126-1131`: `aggregatedRowColumns`, which builds the `having` namespace from `alias ?? field`.
- The engine's fork is `packages/objectql/src/engine-delete-and-aggregate.ts:1431-1488` (`allStructuredSupported`, `tzRequiresInMemory`, `nativeAggregate`).
</details>

<details><summary>Pin and ablation</summary>

The pin at head 0682686528 ran with `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL` set to a local PostgreSQL 16 cluster. Result: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 8 passed | 1 skipped (9)`, `live postgres RAN`. The skipped one is the named live-mysql cell. Lock line: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

Ablation, after the fix was committed:
- `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `const outKey = g.alias ?? g.field;` with `const outKey = g.field /* ablated-35015 */;` in `sql-driver-aggregation.ts`. Anchor count went 1 → 0, blob 1e8180777faa → 524fc156d99c.
- Result: `Tests 4 failed | 4 passed | 1 skipped`. The two alias cases failed on both sqlite and live postgres; the control and the capability case stayed green.
- Restore: blob after restore 1e8180777faa, equal to the HEAD blob; `git diff HEAD` is empty. The suite imports `../src/index.js`, so no `dist/` is involved.
</details>

<details><summary>Package suite and typecheck</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` at 0682686528: `Test Files 261 passed | 13 skipped (274)`, `Tests 4358 passed | 253 skipped (4611)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/driver-sql typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes the new test file.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Claim 6963952530; amendment 6964093495 added `content/docs/protocol/objectql/query-syntax.mdx`.
- Driver defect: none. The SQL face has honoured the alias since #6401. Existing pins on other faces and dialects: `sql-driver-13714-aggregate-alias-single-identifier.test.ts:228-239` (bucket alias, every cell); `sql-driver-aggregation-conformance.test.ts` (`groupByAlias` case, every cell); `sql-driver-33697-zoned-date-bucket.test.ts:181` (zoned PG bucket alias); `packages/objectql/src/in-memory-aggregation.test.ts:44-53` (in-memory `qtr`); `engine-aggregate-having-comparand-shape.test.ts:728` (`having` on the field name is refused once aliased).
- `skip-changeset`: content/docs is not published, and `driver-sql` publishes only `dist`, which carries no test file.

## Verification

- Local gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 82 families, run at f7e7a149f. 81 exited 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, needs a full build), so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to CI. `--ran` reconciliation: 82 accounted, 81 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED.
- The head commit 0682686528 changed only the type-import path in the new test file. These families were re-run at that head, all exit 0: `cross-package-test-inputs`, `test-source-alias`, `nul-bytes`, `undeclared-dep-imports`, `issue-citations`, `engine-double-contract`, `driver-conformance`, `tier-file-adoption`, `where-matcher`, `org-identifier`, `role-word`, `keyed-text-bounds`, `refd-timer-probe`, `objectql-double-limit`, `driver-memory-census`, `comment-mask-adoption`, `comment-mask-corpus`, `doc-authoring`, plus `check-skills-token-ratchet`.
- The CI check-runs are cited in the report once they finish; this body does not wait for them.
